# CcdClip { #imcombiners.CcdClip }

```python
CcdClip(
    sigma=(3.0, 3.0),
    maxiters=5,
    cenfunc='median',
    clip_cen=None,
    ddof=0,
    nkeep=1,
    maxrej=None,
    revert_on_nkeep=True,
    rdnoise=0.0,
    gain=1.0,
    snoise=0.0,
    scale_ref=1.0,
    zero_ref=0.0,
    grow=None,
)
```

CCD noise-model clipping.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**sigma**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [float or tuple of float]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [(3.0, 3.0)]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Clipping threshold in units of the per-pixel std. A scalar applies the same value to both tails; a 2-tuple ``(sigma_lower, sigma_upper)`` clips asymmetrically.

<code>[**maxiters**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [5]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Maximum number of clipping iterations per pixel.

<code>[**ddof**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Delta degrees of freedom for the per-pixel std.

<code>[**nkeep**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [1]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Minimum number of unmasked values to preserve at each pixel. An iteration that would drop below this count is reverted in full. The default, `1`, prevents clipping from rejecting every finite sample in a per-output stack. Set `0` only when all samples may be rejected.

<code>[**maxrej**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [int or None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Maximum number of values that may be rejected at each pixel. `None` means no limit.

<code>[**cenfunc**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [(\'median\', \'lmedian\', \'mean\')]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\"median\"]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Center estimator used each iteration. `lmedian` accepts the alias `lmed` and uses the lower of the two middle samples for even valid counts.

<code>[**clip_cen**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [(\'median\', \'lmedian\', \'mean\')]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [\"median\"]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Center used when computing the spread for iterative rejection. `None` uses the same center as `cenfunc`; `lmedian` also accepts `lmed`.

<code>[**revert_on_nkeep**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [True]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   If `True`, an iteration that would leave fewer than `nkeep` usable samples at a pixel is reverted in full for that pixel. Input masks, threshold masks, and non-finite samples remain excluded. The default is `True`. If `False`, clipping is strict and may leave fewer than `nkeep` samples.

<code>[**rdnoise**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [0.0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Read noise in electrons.

<code>[**gain**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [1.0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   CCD gain in electrons per DN. Rejection is evaluated on gain-corrected values equivalent to ``arr / gain`` without requiring callers to pre-divide the input stack.

<code>[**snoise**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [0.0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Sky-noise coefficient. Adds a Poisson-like contribution scaled by the local count level.

<code>[**scale_ref**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [1.0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Reference scale factor. Typically the inverse of the exposure-time normalization applied during reduction.

<code>[**zero_ref**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [float]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [0.0]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Reference zero-point offset. Accounts for a known DC bias that shifts the effective noise level.

<code>[**grow**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [float or None]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Optional radius in pixels used to grow `mask_rej` spatially after rejection. Axis 0 is the stack axis and is never grown across. `None` disables growth and skips the extra calculation.

### apply { #imcombiners.CcdClip.apply }

```python
CcdClip.apply(arr, mask=None, *, validate=True)
```

Apply CcdClip to an image stack.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

<code>[**arr**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [(ndarray, shape(N, *spatial))]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Image stack. Inputs with more than 3 dimensions are flattened internally; output shapes match the trailing spatial dimensions of the input.

<code>[**mask**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [ndarray of bool]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [None]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   Input mask; `True` means already masked. Must have the same shape as `arr` before any internal flattening.

<code>[**validate**]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [bool]{.parameter-annotation} [ = ]{.parameter-default-sep} [True]{.parameter-default}</code>

:   If `True`, validate inputs before calling the kernel.

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

<code>[]{.parameter-name} [:]{.parameter-annotation-sep} [mask_rej, std, low, upp, nit, output_flags : tuple of ndarray]{.parameter-annotation}</code>

:   Rejection mask and diagnostics from :func:`imcombiners.kernels.ccdclip`. `std` is the per-pixel spread used by sigma/CCD clipping and `None` for rejection algorithms without a spread diagnostic.
